title: Income Tax Preparer
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Income Tax Preparer - Certificate of Achievement - CE1121
outcomes: Use technology to analyze business decisions and to enhance business communications.
Apply basic business and accounting calculations and analyses. Have an understanding of legal practices relating to business.
Apply accounting principles related to a variety of accounting specialties, such as payroll accounting, cost accounting, income tax accounting, and computerized accounting.
Develop and apply principles of moral judgment and ethical behavior to business situations.

notes: The catalog prints codes with a hyphen (e.g. ACC-1A); these were matched to the closed-list codes with a space (ACC 1A, etc.) and are not treated as catalog additions.

The second program learning outcome is printed as a single line containing two sentences ('Apply basic business and accounting calculations and analyses. Have an understanding of legal practices relating to business.'); it is recorded as one outcome as printed. A reviewer may want to check whether the source intends two separate outcomes.

Course status labels in the catalog (Historical, Draft, Active) were omitted from codes; ACC-1A, ACC-19 and ACC-62 are labeled 'Historical' and ACC-67 is labeled 'Draft', which a reviewer may want to verify for the 2026-2027 catalog year.
The award level stated (8-16 semester units) is consistent with the printed 15.00-unit total.
